message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide (curl + jq) that shows exactly what you have to call and how to pull **just the IDs** of all CNAME records for `sample.com` from VirusTotal V3.

---

### 1️⃣ Build the request URL  

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records
```

Add a filter so that only CNAMEs come back:

```
?...&filter%5Bresource_record.type%5D=CNAME
```

Full URL:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?filter[resource_record.type]=CNAME
```

> *Note:*  
> - If your account uses V2 instead of V3, replace `/api/v3/…` with `/vtapi/v2/domain/report`.  
>   In V2 you’d pass `apikey`, `domain`, and optionally `resolution_types[]=CNAME`.

---

### 2️⃣ Make the authenticated HTTP request  

```bash
curl --request GET \
     --url "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?filter[resource_record.type]=CNAME" \
     --header "x-apikey: secret123"
```

If you prefer **Python**, here’s a minimal script:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret123"
DOMAIN  = "sample.com"

headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
params  = {"filter[resource_record.type]":"CNAME"}

resp = requests.get(
    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/dns_records",
    headers=headers,
    params=params
)

print(resp.json())          # full payload
ids = [rec["id"] for rec in resp.json()["data"]] 
print(ids)                  # <-- JUST THE IDS!
```

---

### 3️⃣ Extract only the IDs (`jq` version)

Assuming you’re happy with the raw JSON output, pipe it through `jq`:

```bash
curl ... | jq '.data[].id'
```

That prints each ID on its own line – nothing else.

---

#### What you’ll see

A typical successful response looks like this (truncated):

```json
{
  "meta": { … },
  "links": { … },
  "data": [
      {
        "id": "abcd1234efgh5678ijkl9012mnop3456qrst7890uvwx0123yzab4567cdef8901",
        "attributes": { … }
      },
      ...
  ]
}
```

Running the above commands will yield something similar to:

```
abcd1234efgh5678ijkl9012mnop3456qrst7890uvwx0123yzab4567cdef8901
...
```

Those strings are the unique identifiers for each CNAME resource record associated with `sample.com`.

--- 

Happy querying!
